newsitem.title: USA: Admor Memory calls off Price Point buyout.
newsitem.headline: Admor Memory calls off Price Point buyout.

text.p: Admor Memory Corp said Friday it has rescinded its proposed acquisition of Price Point Microtechnologies Inc.
The two companies signed a letter of intent in November last year and the deal was expected to close last week.
"Admor's primary motivation for acquiring Price Point was to gain access to memory manufacturing," Admor's Chairman, Everett Fuller said in a statement.
Fuller said the company has decided instead to put in place as soon as possible its own state-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.
Admor makes, assembles and sells computer memory products.
